sol.section: Recommended exact spec diff; ISA §12.2 K74 coverage and verdicts

steps.claim: K74 assigns proof to successful componentwise full-D exhaustive claims and evidence to successful exhaustive strict slices.

The proposed addition assigns proof_relative_to_image when all non-fixed components are full-range and all remaining components are fixed_regions bindings. It neither requires any fixed binding nor explicitly replaces K74's blanket strict-slice classification.

Consider a successful exhaustive comparison of a one-bit X action over t=0,1, with no regions or borrowed systems and fixed_regions absent or empty. Every non-fixed component is full-range and there are no remaining components, so the added condition holds vacuously: K74 assigns proof while the addition assigns proof_relative_to_image. For the proposed 64-case image slice, retained K74 instead assigns evidence while the addition assigns proof_relative_to_image.
steps.by: witness:full domain bundles=[{name:t,width:1,lo:0,hi:1}], borrowed=[], regions=[], expected table 0→1 and 1→0; witness:proposal's 64-case image slice; step:<1>1; step:<1>2

steps.claim: The amended text gives overlapping outcomes without a precedence rule. In particular, the claimed preservation of old full-D K74 labels is not secured.

sol.fix: §12.2, preferred repair: replace K74's classification sentences with: 'After every §12.1 obligation succeeds, an exhaustive table/program/oracle claim receives exactly one verdict: proof if its domain equals unrestricted D component by component; otherwise proof_relative_to_image iff fixed_regions is nonempty, every image binding is valid, and every non-fixed component occurs exactly once with its full range; otherwise evidence. An absent fixed_regions field means an empty list. Successful sampled claims always receive evidence. Coverage remains the exact n/|D| against unrestricted D. A requested proof MUST be rejected unless the computed verdict is proof; a requested proof_relative_to_image MUST satisfy the qualified-verdict conditions.' Preserve mismatch rejection and K75 host-limit handling. Expected outcomes: the full-domain one-bit X claim receives proof with fraction 1; the exhaustive 0102 image claim receives proof_relative_to_image with 64 elements and fraction 1/65536; sampling remains evidence. Alternatively, retain K74's full-D sentence, add the explicit nonempty guard, and replace its strict-slice sentence with 'Successful exhaustive strict slices receive evidence unless they satisfy the proof_relative_to_image rule.' I prefer the single exclusive classifier.
